label: Lookup
description: A reference from this record to one record of another (or the same) entity, such as a ticket's parent ticket or an asset's vendor. The value is the target record's ID. The viewer sees the target's title only if they may read the target; otherwise the value shows as "Restricted record". Every lookup is described by a relationship spec that sets what happens when the target is deleted.
usage: Use when the options are records with their own data and lifecycle.
Add a spec_object.relationship for the lookup with a clear inverse label ("Child tickets") so it can appear as a related list.
Use onTargetDelete: clear for optional references and restrict when the reference must stay intact.
constraints: target is required and must be an existing entity ID.
Each lookup needs exactly one spec_object.relationship (entity, field, target) declaring onTargetDelete: restrict or clear.
The picker only offers records the viewer may read; linking a record never grants access to it.
If the viewer cannot read the referenced record, it renders as "Restricted record" with no title, number, or link, and an unrelated save keeps the value unchanged.

target.description: Target entity ID, e.g. core.tickets.ticket or tenant__vendor.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Typing searches target records by title and number; Up/Down move; Enter selects; Esc closes. In read mode Enter opens the target.
accessibility.notes: Options announce title and number; a restricted value is announced as "Restricted record".

responsive: Full width of its grid cell; search opens as a full-screen sheet below 720px.
